meta.title: Ivan Kakurov – Senior Software Engineer
meta.description: Ivan Kakurov – Senior Software Engineer with 13+ years of end-to-end ownership of production platforms (PHP/Symfony, Python/Django): ships spec-first with AI agents through a risk-gated agentic SDLC, APIs and integrations, GitOps delivery on Kubernetes. Sofia, Bulgaria.

personal.tagline: Senior Software Engineer · AI-augmented delivery · PHP/Symfony · Python/Django · GitOps on Kubernetes

languages.name: English
languages.level: Professional working proficiency (daily written & technical communication)

summary: Software engineer with 13+ years of owning production platforms end-to-end — from the first business question through architecture, APIs and data models to delivery and performance in production. AI-augmented every day: ships spec-first with Claude Code and Codex agents through my open-source Agentic SDLC, where each change's risk tier sets its review, security and test gates and a human reads every plan, test and diff before merge; model routing by tier cut the cost of contained changes by 32%. Architect of a global commerce platform (5 legal entities, 15 payment integrations, ERP/CRM sync) and its GitOps delivery on Kubernetes. Open-source plugin author (JetBrains, Sylius).
educationNote: Self-taught engineer — 13+ years of hands-on learning in production systems and published open-source work.

description: Own abrites.com end-to-end — a global commerce platform for 5 legal entities (B2B, B2C, B2B2C) with per-client dynamic pricing — from the first business question to production support.

Brought an AI-augmented workflow into the Abrites codebases with my open-source Claude Agentic SDLC: risk tiers set each change's review, security and test gates, guard hooks protect legacy behaviour, and a human reads every AI-generated plan, test and diff before it ships.

Integrated 15 payment providers (8 built from scratch for regional requirements), ERP/CRM synchronization and a Dolibarr ERP. Work across PHP and Python in one production estate: the commerce platform, a Symfony-based CMS, an event management system and the internal ERP/CRM (Python/Django + PostgreSQL, REST API).

Built the GitOps delivery platform on Kubernetes everything ships through: one generic Helm chart, Argo CD syncing from self-hosted GitLab CI, pinned and compatibility-tested versions, isolated legacy runtimes.
Large-scale Magento (Adobe Commerce) projects with the Dutch agency Diract: core customizations, B2B modules and processes, a redesigned checkout and invoicing pipeline.
Built the Docker-based CI/CD production flow: containerized environments, build and test pipelines, deployments to Linode.
Developed and maintained projects across the full range of scale — from landing pages to complex systems for banks and insurance companies.
Built custom e-commerce solutions from scratch.
Worked on a variety of small to mid-scale websites and APIs.

items.name: Claude Agentic SDLC
items.brief: open-source agentic delivery pipeline: risk-tiered review, security and test gates, human approval.
items.description: Agentic delivery pipeline for Claude Code and Codex, built for legacy production codebases. Each change gets a risk tier (T0–T5) that sets its gates — planning, review, security and test agents, plus guard hooks against out-of-scope edits and pushes to protected branches — and ends at human approval. Tier-based model routing cut the cost of contained (T2) changes by 32%, and cost per request by 8.3% across 7,054 requests. Ships with its own test suite and GitHub Actions CI.

items.name: Vanssa Sylius Slider
items.brief: published Sylius 2 plugin built spec-first; PHPUnit, Behat, Playwright, GitHub Actions CI.
items.description: Feature-rich responsive slider plugin for Sylius 2, published on the official Sylius Addons store — translatable image and video slides, live admin previews, Symfony UX rendering, Twig Hooks, and optional CMS integrations. Tested with PHPUnit, Behat and Playwright; CI on GitHub Actions. Developed through my agentic SDLC pipeline from human-authored specifications, with every plan, test and diff reviewed before merge.
